Game Overview

In Sprunki Run, the core idea is straightforward: join the charming Sprunki team for an endless dash of excitement, where reflexes are key. Choose doors wisely, solve math puzzles for powerful boosts, and dodge obstacles. Jump, grow your squad, and outsmart foes in this vibrant, fast-paced 2D adventure. How long can your wits carry you?
